say:1:1330903001:1.text: I'm not trying to make things difficult for you, but you must give me a good reason why I can't visit the Archduke.
say:1:1330903001:1.source_cn: 我无意为难你，但你必须给我一个合理的理由。告诉我，为何...

say:4:1330903002:1.text: My apologies, Viscount Zander. This is a court order.
say:4:1330903002:1.source_cn: ……很抱歉，子爵大人，这是来自帝国皇庭的命令。

say:7:1330903003:1.text: What? The court?! Dura above, what on earth has happened...
say:7:1330903003:1.source_cn: 什么？皇庭？！艾雅在上，到底发生了什么……

say:10:1330903004:1.text: I humbly ask for your forgiveness, as I'm not permitted to reveal anything. For your safety, I respectfully request that you leave.
say:10:1330903004:1.source_cn: 请您原谅，我……我不能说。为了您的安全，还请您先离开。
